findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "arc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arc_agent_status, x402_inspect · Private data: arc_exit_check, arc_exit_check_bulk, arc_agent_status, arc_touchstone, arc_passport_draft, arc_passport_confirm, arc_passport_buy, arc_passport_status, arc_verdict, arc_counterparty, arc_payment_check, arc_gas, arc_fee_flow, arc_cctp_cost, arc_graveyard, arc_impostors, arc_deployers, arc_fresh_launches, arc_hook_risk, arc_agent_market, arc_wallet, arc_contract_check, arc_agent_reputation, erc8004_how_to · Public sink: arc_passport_confirm, arc_passport_status, arc_impostors · Destructive: arc_grow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: arc_agent_status, x402_inspect · Private data: arc_exit_check, arc_exit_check_bulk, arc_agent_status, arc_touchstone, arc_passport_draft, arc_passport_confirm, arc_passport_buy, arc_passport_status, arc_verdict, arc_counterparty, arc_payment_check, arc_gas, arc_fee_flow, arc_cctp_cost, arc_graveyard, arc_impostors, arc_deployers, arc_fresh_launches, arc_hook_risk, arc_agent_market, arc_wallet, arc_contract_check, arc_agent_reputation, erc8004_how_to · Public sink: arc_passport_confirm, arc_passport_status, arc_impostors · Destructive: arc_grow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
